body.x: LG Electronics(www.lge.co.kr) announced 'G FLEX' at 'CES Unveiled' of the CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

G Flex is a flexible phone that delivers a more comfortable grip and fit as well as offers improved voice and sound quality. G Flex with the stunning vertical curve also has features that a rear key to let users avoid accidentally powering off the device, QTheater, Dual Window and Face Detection technology, a camera timer and an urgent call alert system. In addition, the flexible cell phone shows off a “self-healing” coating on the back cover, which gives the innovative G Flex the ability to recover from scratches and nicks.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
